spec.title: Discovery
spec.body:
Walk GOV tree for VITAE.md files across all governed repos. Cross-reference against cert/ tags in TAGS.md. Only developers with matching cert tags are listed.

```
GOV tree → VITAE.md discovery → cert/ tag match → developers.json → FOUNDATION page
```

---

spec.title: Card Schema
spec.body:
| Field | Source | Required |
|-------|--------|----------|
| name | VITAE.md | YES |
| github | VITAE.md | YES |
| title | VITAE.md | YES |
| org | GALAXY inheritance | YES |
| tier | cert/ tag | YES |
| tier_score | magic validate | YES |
| focus | VITAE.md | NO |
| vitae_url | Compiled route | YES |
| cert_date | cert/ tag date | YES |
| cert_tag | Git tag ref | YES |

---

spec.title: Sort
spec.body:
By tier (FULL first), then alphabetical within tier.

---

spec.title: Surface
spec.body:
FOUNDATION page renders developer cards. Each card links to VITAE. Each card has "Verify This Credential" — checkout cert tag, run `magic validate`, get same score.

intel.title: Cross-Axiomatic References
intel.body:
| Scope | Relationship | What flows |
|-------|-------------|-----------|
| CERTIFICATION | Upstream | Tier definitions, tag convention — what certification means |
| VITAE | Upstream | Professional credentials — source data for developer cards |
| GALAXY | Topology | ORG membership — routes developer to org |
| TAGS.md | Registry | cert/ tags — which developers are certified |
| SALES | Downstream | Enterprise contact flow — buyer discovers certified team |
| TALK | Downstream | Governed CHAT — buyer contacts developer via TALK overlay |

intel.title: Migration Pattern
intel.body:
INTEL carries developer knowledge across scopes without exposing internals:

```
VITAE (full record)       → INTEL → DEVELOPERS (public card subset)
CERTIFICATION (tier)      → INTEL → DEVELOPERS (badge display)
DEVELOPERS (listing)      → INTEL → SALES (proof in deal cycle)
DEVELOPERS (contact)      → INTEL → TALK (governed conversation)
```
